text: Your home loan will not come as one big amount.
For construction, the bank releases it in stages, as the building goes up.
Stages like plinth, slab, walls and finishing. Each one gets checked before the next part is released.
But your contractor and your material bills do not wait for the bank.
So between two releases, you may need to cover the gap yourself.
Before you sign, ask your bank three things.
What are the stages? What do you need to see before each release? And how long does a release take?
Then plan your own cash for each gap, and confirm the details with your bank or C A.
Send this to someone building this year.
